body:
> Note that adjusting UV2 Scale/Offset will affect baking, but it doesn't affect the real-time emission map in either Forward+ or Compatibility here. I'm not sure if this is a bug (and whether we should remove the UV2 Scale/Offset adjustment from the voxelizer).

I would fix this in the same PR if possible. 

Could you investigate fixing this for dynamic objects? I think what is needed is to implement sampling using UV2 since the attributes are basically rendered into a quad that represents UVs 0-1

We discussed this in the rendering meeting and are concerned that supporting `emission_on_uv2` for baked VoxelGI, but not for the other GI methods might be the wrong approach. If we can't support dynamic VoxelGI, SDFGI, and LightmapGI, it would probably be best to instead just fail to just warn the user instead that `emission_on_uv2` isn't supported
